rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=6, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=24, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.0001, unet_c=16, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-9 CEILING-CONFIRMATION (cleaner-read) PROBE: ONE knob val_n 16->24 on the iter-4/iter-8 PEAK cfg (ep6, lr=1e-4, c16, n_iter300, grad_clip1.0, seed42 -> 0.9596/0.9597). grad_clip reset 0.5->1.0 (iter-8 confirmed gc-insensitive, 0.9596->0.9597 flat; revert to the mandatory 1.0 floor so val_n is the ONLY change vs the iter-4 peak). NOT-yet-tried axis = the VAL-SUBSET SAMPLING of the SSIM read: how many per-scan-fit val images are averaged. Enlarging the scored set 16->24 perturbs ONLY which/how-many scans contribute to the mean, NOT any optimization-strength knob, so it directly tests whether 0.9596 is a 16-scan small-sample artefact or a true substrate ceiling. (Forbidden/known knobs avoided: n_iter HURTS via per-scan overfit -- iter-2 n_iter600 0.9553->0.9407; warm_start is LOAD-BEARING-POSITIVE, do NOT turn off; unet_c is NOT the lever -- iter-6 c16->c32 0.9596->0.9495.) Failure mode: per-image U-Net N2I on dense-view 128-angle breast is STRUCTURALLY FBP-BOUNDED -- the half-angle view-split discards information the full-view LD-FBP keeps, so each per-scan GT-free fit caps BELOW the 128-view LD-FBP baseline (hr=0). All optimization/capacity levers exhausted and inert around 0.9596: lr anchored 1e-4 (iter-3 0.9553->0.9593), n_iter overfits (iter-2 down to 0.9407), pretrain saturated (ep3->6 up 0.9593->0.9596, 6->12 down 0.9585 iter-5), capacity flat (iter-6 c32 0.9495), seed noise-stable (iter-7 0.9588), grad_clip flat (iter-8 0.9597). Hypothesis: 0.9596 is a substrate FBP-bound ceiling, not a 16-scan sampling artefact -- reading 24 val scans lands within noise of 0.9596 (hr stays 0), documenting that the ~0.96 per-image U-Net N2I breast ceiling is val-subset-stable toward the iter-20 mandate. A material drop would mean the 16-scan read was optimistically sampled; a material lift would mean pessimistically sampled (either way a read-stability note, not a new lever). Wall: iter-8 (val_n16) ran 485s; +50% val scans, per-scan fit dominates -> est ~700-720s, well under the 900s/15min wall (outer_wall_s=1500 hard cap).
